description: This line plot illustrates the change in Word Error Rate (WER) over six epochs for four different fine-tuning methods applied to a small Whisper model, as detailed in the paper “Abstractive summarization from Audio Transcription.” The x-axis represents the epoch number, ranging from 0 to 6, with tick marks at integer intervals. The y-axis represents the WER, scaled linearly from 25.0 to 42.5. Four distinct lines are plotted: “small AdaLoRA_int4” (orange solid line with circle markers), “small AdaLoRA_int8” (orange dashed line with circle markers), “small int4” (orange solid line with square markers), and “small int8” (orange dashed line with square markers). The “small AdaLoRA_int4” line starts at a WER of 35.5 at epoch 0, peaks at 42.0 at epoch 2, and ends at 30.5 at epoch 6. The “small AdaLoRA_int8” line begins at 35.5 at epoch 0, dips to 25.0 at epoch 5, and ends at 25.0 at epoch 6. The “small int4” line starts at 30.0 at epoch 0, decreases to 25.0 at epoch 6, and remains relatively stable in between. The “small int8” line begins at 30.0 at epoch 0, decreases to 25.0 at epoch 6, and remains relatively stable in between.
